| **Slowest / 2700 s** | **705 s (26.1 %)** | **916 s (33.9 %)** | **715 s (26.5 %)** | **256 s (9.5 %)** |

The slowest job over the 10 runs is `firmware-control-mutants` at 916 s, 33.9 % of its 45-minute timeout, against the 70 % bound (1,890 s). Item 2 is met at this head; the earlier table at `f41e4f2d` is superseded.
